description:
Reporting Line

Reports to the Team Lead.

Location

Fully remote — open to candidates worldwide, no timezone requirement.

General Purpose

Expand the C++ engineering team's capacity to deliver new functionality — building scalable, high-performance server-side services and integrations that the business is actively betting on.

Specific Objectives

Ship the MT4/5 server-side plugin to production

Design, develop, and deliver a stable MetaTrader 4/5 server plugin within the first 12 months, meeting defined functional and performance requirements.

Deploy Windows services

Architect and ship at least one Windows server-side service that performs reliably under production load, with documented deployment and operational runbooks.

Establish a stable multithreaded codebase

Ensure all delivered components are written to modern C++ standards (C++17 or later), with multithreading correctness verified through code review and testing.

Key Activities

Design and develop server-side components

Write, review, and maintain high-performance C++ code for server-side services and plugins, including the MT4/5 server-side plugin and Windows services.

Write and debug multithreaded code

Design concurrent systems using modern C++ (C++17 or later), identify and resolve race conditions, deadlocks, and other threading issues through rigorous testing and review.

Diagnose and fix software defects

Investigate reported defects, trace root causes, implement fixes, and verify resolution — closing the loop so the same class of bug doesn't recur.

Participate in code reviews and automated testing

Review peers' code for correctness, performance, and maintainability; contribute to the automated test suite to keep the codebase reliable as it grows.

Collaborate on architecture decisions

Work with the Team Lead and peers to define scalable, maintainable service architectures that meet current and future business requirements.

Maintain documentation

Keep runbooks, design notes, and operational guides up to date for all delivered components.

Key Competences

Modern C++ fluency

Writes production-quality C++17 (or later) code confidently — including templates, move semantics, smart pointers, and STL — without needing to be shown the basics.

Multithreading and concurrency

Designs and debugs concurrent systems correctly: understands memory models, synchronisation primitives, and common failure modes such as deadlocks and data races.

Financial protocols and domain awareness

Practical experience with FIX protocol — message types, session management, and performance considerations — ideally in a trading or brokerage context.

Windows server-side development

Comfortable building and deploying services on Windows Server environments; familiar with Windows-specific APIs and service lifecycle management.

Low-ego collaboration

Works effectively in a small, remote team: communicates clearly in writing, flags blockers early, and reviews others' code constructively.

Likely Current Job

C++ Developer / Software Engineer (C++) at a fintech, brokerage, trading platform, or financial infrastructure firm — writing server-side or low-latency components in C++17 or later.

MT4/MT5 Plugin or Integration Developer — someone who has built or maintained server-side plugins for MetaTrader platforms, either in-house at a broker or at a third-party vendor. Nice to have.

FIX Engine / Connectivity Developer — a developer specialising in FIX protocol integrations at a broker, exchange, or trading technology vendor.

Windows Systems / Backend Developer (C++) — a backend engineer with a strong Windows native development background, looking to move into financial services.

C++/C# Developer in adjacent domains — game server, telecoms, or systems software engineers with demonstrable multithreading depth and some C# exposure who are ready to cross into fintech. Nice to have: C# experience.

Employer Value Proposition

You'll work on a focused, technically demanding stack — modern C++, FIX protocol, MT4/5 — where the problems are real and the work ships to production. This is a role for someone who wants to own meaningful components end-to-end, not maintain legacy code in a committee.

The team is small and remote-first, which means less noise and more autonomy. There's no timezone requirement, so you structure your day around the work. And because the business is actively investing in new functionality, there's room to grow with the product rather than wait for someone to retire.

Compensation

Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

Assessment Process

Standard hiring process managed in collaboration with HR.
